claims.text: What the strip looks like The pacer is inhibited when it shouldn't be.
claims.quote: Oversensing: Pacer inhibited when it shouldn't be (T-wave oversensing, myopotentials)

claims.text: Aspects (abnormal in red) Pacing: inhibited when it shouldn't be
claims.quote: Oversensing: Pacer inhibited when it shouldn't be (T-wave oversensing, myopotentials)

claims.text: The false signal: may not be evident on the ECG
claims.quote: Abnormal signals may not be evident on ECG

claims.text: On monitoring: reduced output or output failure may be seen if the patient stimulates their rectus or pectoral muscles (oversensing of muscle activity)
claims.quote: Reduced pacemaker output / output failure may be seen on ECG monitoring if the patient stimulates their rectus or pectoral muscles (due to oversensing of muscle activity)

claims.text: Causes (mechanism and diagnoses) Mechanism: electrical signals are wrongly recognized as native cardiac activity, so pacing is inhibited
claims.quote: Oversensing occurs when electrical signal are inappropriately recognised as native cardiac activity and pacing is inhibited
Oversensing: Pacer inhibited when it shouldn't be (T-wave oversensing, myopotentials)

claims.text: The signals may be large P or T waves, skeletal muscle activity or lead contact problems
claims.quote: These inappropriate signals may be large P or T waves, skeletal muscle activity or lead contact problems

claims.text: Output failure: no paced stimulus is generated when one is expected
claims.quote: Output failure occurs when a paced stimulus is not generated in a situation where expected

claims.text: Output failure has multiple causes, including oversensing, wire fracture, lead displacement, or interference
claims.quote: Multiple causes including oversensing, wire fracture, lead displacement, or interference

claims.text: Symptoms Often non-specific symptoms; the ECG changes can be subtle or absent
claims.quote: Diagnosis of pacemaker malfunction is challenging and often associated with non-specific clinical symptoms while ECG changes can be subtle or absent

claims.text: Treatment Suspected malfunction needs cardiology review for pacemaker interrogation and testing
claims.quote: If pacemaker malfunction is suspected cardiology review is required to facilitate pacemaker interrogation and testing
